object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window you activated for ${entitlementName} has now been deactivated, and access has been removed.

#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here to view details or reactivate this entitlement if needed.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to the identity whose active Just-In-Time activation window has been deactivated. Notifies them that access has been removed and points them back to Launchpad to reactivate if needed.
object.name: Just-In-Time Deactivated
object.subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} has been deactivated
